picks.title: Hamas agrees to Trump's plan to disarm in Gaza
picks.summary: Hamas has agreed to Trump's plan to disarm in Gaza, a major step in the ceasefire framework, coming alongside Trump's announcement that he is holding off on further strikes on Iran while a broader regional deal is negotiated.
flags: Whether Hamas actually follows through on disarmament, and whether Israeli forces withdraw as promised, remains to be seen

picks.title: Spain installs sea barrier on Ceuta's border with Morocco after frontier rush that killed 67
picks.summary: Spain has installed a physical sea barrier at its Ceuta enclave after a mass border rush from Morocco left 67 people dead, escalating the crisis that has already triggered an emergency EU meeting; residents of Ceuta have separately pushed back against a far-right anti-migrant rally.
flags: Confirmed death toll of 67 makes this one of the deadliest migration incidents at this border in years

picks.bucket: US as the world sees it
picks.title: Idaho fast food restaurant shooting leaves 3 dead and 7 injured
picks.summary: A shooting at a fast food restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho left three dead and seven injured, the latest in a string of American mass-shooting incidents that continue to draw international attention to US gun violence.

picks.title: Nation 2 Nation: America's F-35 fighter jet crashed
picks.origTitle: Nation 2 Nation: अमेरिका का F-35 विमान हुआ क्रैश | America Fighter Jet Accident
picks.summary: India's state broadcaster's international affairs show covers a reported American F-35 fighter jet crash, part of its coverage of the broader Iran conflict fallout.

picks.title: Did Iran's 'dangerous' plan stop Trump from attacking?
picks.origTitle: क्या ईरान के इस 'ख़तरनाक' प्लान ने ट्रंप को हमला करने से रोक दिया है?
picks.summary: BBC Hindi analyzes whether a threatened Iranian retaliation plan is what actually pushed Trump to hold off on further strikes, offering independent analysis beyond the official 'deal is near' framing.

picks.title: 5G didn't stop China — now the US wants to trip it up on 6G
picks.origTitle: 5G没拦住中国，美国又想在6G上使绊｜真相
picks.summary: Chinese state media frames US moves around 6G standards as another attempt to contain China's tech rise, following the same pattern it says failed to stop China's 5G lead.
flags: Framed explicitly as US containment narrative — a recurring state-media theme

picks.title: A refugee from Rodinske described how Ukrainian forces drone-attacked homes with people inside
picks.origTitle: Беженка из Родинского рассказала, как ВСУ дронами атаковали дома с людьми
picks.summary: Russian state media features testimony from a refugee accusing Ukrainian forces of drone-striking occupied homes, part of a recurring narrative casting Ukraine as targeting civilians.
flags: State-media source — treat framing with caution; a single unverified testimony presented as fact

picks.title: Moscow's mayor calls the restaurant blast a terror attack; death toll rises to five
picks.origTitle: Собянин назвал взрыв в московском ресторане терактом. По данным телеграм-каналов, число погибших выросло до пяти человек
picks.summary: Moscow's mayor Sergei Sobyanin has officially labeled the restaurant explosion a terrorist attack; Telegram channels now report the death toll has risen to five, up from the initial count of three.
flags: Death toll based on Telegram channel reports, not yet officially confirmed

picks.title: Japan and US to intervene jointly against yen weakness, joint statement expected August 3
picks.origTitle: 円安是正へ日米が異例の協調介入 3日に日米共同の声明発表へ
picks.summary: Japan and the US are preparing an unusual coordinated currency intervention to correct yen weakness, with a joint Japan-US statement expected August 3 — a significant and rare bilateral monetary move.

picks.title: No water, no power — 8 staff carried patients up six flights as the hospital itself was damaged
picks.origTitle: 断水、停電･･･8人で患者担ぎ6階へ　病院も被災、葛藤の医療現場
picks.summary: The Asahi Shimbun reports from inside a Kumamoto hospital damaged by the earthquake, where staff carried patients up six flights of stairs by hand amid water and power outages — a ground-level look beyond the official casualty figures.

picks.title: Vermont keeps a list of where large crowds gather. The feds get a copy.
picks.summary: VTDigger reports that Vermont maintains a list of locations where large crowds gather, and that this information is shared with federal authorities, raising questions about surveillance and civil liberties.
flags: Raises privacy/surveillance concerns about state-federal data sharing

picks.title: 'Sowing in the sea': researchers and fishermen optimize oyster farming in Puerto Rico
picks.origTitle: "Sembrar en el mar": investigadores y pescadores optimizan el cultivo de ostras en Puerto Rico
picks.summary: Researchers and local fishermen in Puerto Rico are collaborating to improve oyster farming techniques, a small but notable step toward diversifying the island's coastal economy and food production.

picks.title: Sony acknowledges backlash, 'cautiously' moves ahead with end of PlayStation discs
picks.summary: Sony acknowledged strong backlash over its plan to end physical PlayStation discs, but says it will proceed cautiously rather than reverse course, keeping the digital-only transition on track for now.

picks.title: AI scammers outperform humans when it comes to building trust
picks.summary: New research finds AI-driven scam operations are more effective than human scammers at building victims' trust, raising fresh concerns about the scale and sophistication of AI-enabled fraud.

picks.title: Generative AI floods and dilutes the market for books
picks.summary: A new study finds generative AI is flooding the book market with low-effort titles, diluting discoverability and quality for readers and human authors alike.

picks.title: A big win for Android interoperability
picks.summary: The Open Home Foundation reports a significant interoperability win for Android, easing integration for smart-home and third-party developers.

picks.title: Chained Soldier TV Anime Gets 3rd Season
picks.summary: Chained Soldier has been renewed for a third TV anime season, continuing the series' run.
